desc: The Breek Arms Direct Thread Universal Suppressor HUB, engineered to provide a simple, secure, and repeatable mounting solution for HUB compatible suppressors. Designed for shooters who value durability, precision, and minimal added length. It’s tough, wear-resistant finish with Black DLC on titanium models or Nitride on stainless models, delivering exceptional hardness and corrosion resistance to thrive in heavy use and harsh conditions.
